Iron Man, wearing his gleaming red and gold metallic armor with a glowing blue chest arc reactor, hovers in the air with bright thrusters firing from his boots. He raises his right metallic gauntlet, shooting a glowing energy beam from his palm. Spider-Man, dressed in his classic red and blue suit with black web patterns and large white eye lenses, leaps dynamically through the air. He twists his flexible body to dodge the energy beam while extending his left wrist to shoot a thick white web line directly toward Iron Man. In the background, tall glass skyscrapers stand under a clear, deep blue sky. Small pieces of concrete debris fall through the air from the battle, and smoke drifts across the street.
